comments.body: how to make recipe to make this to show up?

comments.author: Holfina
comments.body: Develop your farm at Savaii; need farm development around 700. Also need a farm producing silk.

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body: I recently got this from Local Pirates A, just outside of Seville. On deck battling a single LPA with r2+1 plunder, I received 1 ex-velvet... half an hour (and many local pirates later), I got a second velvet, in the exact same way. Seemed like a really rare drop, but if you only need a few and don't feel like heading out to Savaii (or lack a Savaii farm entirely), it's not a bad way of getting them.

comments.author: H.-Gazi
comments.body: These are also obtainable at Rome Church, at Floor 5 chests and sometimes after battle as well.

comments.author: Tammer
comments.body: Can also be plundered from Shetland Pirates, who ambush in Northern Britain Island (near where the actual Shetland Islands are).
